headline: Names a post office in Fairport, New York, after Louise and Bob Slaughter.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 770 Ayrault Road in Fairport, New York, as the Louise and Bob Slaughter Post Office. It is a ceremonial designation and does not change how the post office operates or what services it offers. The official summary describes only the naming.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on August 21, 2019.
